late_table_repairs.method: Explicit three-column OCR prompt; validate all rows before replacement; preserve previous tables and raw responses. Original detector crops are unchanged.
late_table_repairs.renderer_fix: Natural-height rows with no hidden cell overflow; visible source-resolution-scaled grid rules; preserved column widths.
late_table_repairs.limitations: These are still model transcriptions. Some section rows remain grouped, and spelling/word omissions remain; validation establishes renderable structure, not exact cell accuracy.

ocr.table_retry: The large troubleshooting table on vespa_manual_31.png hit context/output limits and repeated merged rows. Its original crop is preserved; a Lanczos maximum-side-1800 retry input and no-merged-cells prompt produced a normally stopped simplified three-column table. The transform is recorded in the output element and raw request audit. Rows and brace annotations are not faithfully reconstructed.
ocr.method: All detected non-figure regions, including titles and abandon, are transcribed by Qwen. Tables use an HTML-table prompt. No Tesseract or old OCR fallback. Figures remain unchanged crops.

caveats: This is an automated OCR output, not a fully corrected manual.
Detection and OCR can omit or misread text. The fresh cover crop reads Vespa 150 correctly but its emblem transcription omits the small P.
Normal stop and HTML table completion checks do not establish transcription accuracy.
The table on source page vespa_manual_31.png uses a simplified structure after retry; exact row relationships and brace annotations need review.
